nodes.name: Every 10 Minutes
nodes.notes: Poll interval. 5 / 10 / 20 minutes are all sane; anything under 5 mostly burns API quota.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Reads the rubric and all three caps from env vars. Caps live in config, never in a prompt.

nodes.name: Caps Preflight
nodes.notes: Circuit breaker + spend window + run clock. Sets blocked=true instead of throwing, so the false branch can alert.

nodes.name: Caps OK?
nodes.notes: True = run. False = the breaker or a cap stopped this run.

nodes.name: Upwork GraphQL Search
nodes.notes: Official Upwork GraphQL API over OAuth2. READ ONLY - this is a search query and nothing else. Never point this at a browser-automation endpoint.

nodes.name: Normalize Jobs
nodes.notes: Maps the GraphQL response onto the flat job shape the scorer expects. Change field mapping here, never in the scorer.

nodes.name: Score Jobs
nodes.notes: Embedded copy of workflows/code-nodes/score.js + caps.js. Built by scripts/build_workflow.py - do not edit here.

nodes.name: Passed Threshold?
nodes.notes: Only jobs at or above the configured alert threshold continue. Everything else is dropped silently.

nodes.name: Skip Already Alerted
nodes.notes: One alert per job id, ever. Static data survives restarts.

nodes.name: Format Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Renders the score breakdown + a DRAFT opener. Nothing is sent to Upwork here or anywhere else.

nodes.name: Post Alert to Slack
nodes.notes: The only outbound side effect in the whole workflow: a Slack message to a human.

nodes.name: Persist State
nodes.notes: Clears the error streak, rolls the spend window, keeps 500 rows of history for the digest.

nodes.name: Build Breaker Alert
nodes.notes: Explains which cap stopped the run. Also the ONLY node that calls recordError() - without it the breaker could never trip.

nodes.name: Post Breaker Alert
nodes.notes: Fires when the breaker is open or a cap was hit.

nodes.name: Build Digest
nodes.notes: Summarises the last 24h from persisted history, including caps headroom.

nodes.name: Post Digest to Slack
nodes.notes: One digest a day, whether or not anything passed.

meta.description: Read-only Upwork job radar. Polls the official API, scores each job against a configurable rubric, alerts a human in Slack. Never submits a proposal, never sends a message, never spends a Connect.
